name: Lordly Resolve

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/character-options.

summary: Reference-only: Once per Long Rest, Bonus Action selects up to three creatures within 60 feet who see you. Each can spend a Reaction to stand if Speed is not 0. For 1 minute or until you are Incapacitated, they cannot become possessed, Charmed, or Frightened; existing such effects instead allow Advantage on new saves.
